note: Each box is solved with only the memory available before it. Growing memory inserts the growing agent's completed solve afterwards (first write wins) and bills insertion to that box. Each stream has its own memory copy starting from the same frozen base table. Streams are declared before evaluation; no task is chosen by checking memory. Retrieval is exact state identity; transformation matching is excluded. Initial-state and intermediate hits are reported separately. Streams, not seeds, are the independent units.
